triggers.name: trg_characters_node_change_participation
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_characters_node_change_participation AFTER UPDATE OF current_node_id ON characters FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.current_node_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.current_node_id AND old.current_node_id IS NOT NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION characters_end_participation_on_node_change()

triggers.name: trg_characters_sync_stance_effects
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_characters_sync_stance_effects AFTER UPDATE OF reserved_buffs ON characters FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.reserved_buffs IS DISTINCT FROM old.reserved_buffs) EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_stance_effects()
